title: Institutional Books - Enriched Text: A customizable multilingual open-source pipeline for denoising, deduplicating, and annotating OCR text at scale
abstract: arXiv:2608.19026v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Released in 2025, Institutional Books: Harvard Library (IB-HL) is a collection of 983,004 volumes (242B o200k_base tokens), originally digitized through Harvard Library's participation in the Google Books Library project. As researchers and developers have begun to use IB-HL, a tension has emerged between standard large-scale preprocessing practices and the goals of careful information stewardship. Many existing pipelines optimize for web text: as a result, they tend to aggressively filter, deduplicate, restrict by language, and sometimes discard meaningful metadata. Meanwhile, researchers seeking to use IB-HL duplicate effort while performing similar processing and analysis.   We describe an approach that we call Enriched Text. Instead of producing a single 'complete' stream of tokens, we normalize the text while preserving metadata through annotations. translated_title: 机构书籍——增强文本：一种可定制的多语言开源流程，用于大规模去噪、去重和标注OCR文本
translated_abstract: 2025年发布的《机构书籍：哈佛图书馆》（IB-HL）是一个包含983,004卷（2420亿个o200k_base标记）的收藏集，最初通过哈佛图书馆参与谷歌图书图书馆项目进行数字化。随着研究人员和开发者开始使用IB-HL，标准的大规模预处理实践与细致信息管理目标之间出现了张力。许多现有流程针对网络文本优化：因此，它们倾向于激进过滤、去重、按语言限制，有时甚至丢弃有意义的元数据。同时，希望使用IB-HL的研究人员在进行类似处理和分析时重复了工作。我们描述了一种称为“增强文本”的方法。我们不是生成单一的“完整”标记流，而是通过注释保留元数据的同时规范化文本。我们分离书末内容，检测每段语言，识别重复簇。
tldr: 本文提出“增强文本”方法，通过保留元数据的注释方式替代传统激进过滤，实现大规模OCR文本的可定制去噪、去重和标注。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an "Enriched Text" approach that preserves metadata through annotations instead of aggressive filtering, enabling customizable denoising, deduplication, and annotation of large-scale OCR text.
